questions.stem: Who was the first woman President of India?
questions.explanation: Pratibha Devisingh Patil — 12th President of India (2007-2012) — was the FIRST WOMAN President of India. Droupadi Murmu — 15th President (2022-present) — is the SECOND woman AND the first tribal (Santhal) President. Sarojini Naidu was the first woman GOVERNOR of UP (1947-49) and first woman president of INC (1925). Indira Gandhi was first woman PM (1966-77, 1980-84) — never President.

questions.stem: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of an Indian state?
questions.explanation: SUCHETA KRIPLANI (wife of J.B. Kriplani) was the FIRST woman CM of any Indian state — Chief Minister of UTTAR PRADESH from 2 October 1963 to 13 March 1967. Freedom fighter, INC member, Constituent Assembly member. Sung 'Vande Mataram' in the Constituent Assembly on the night of 14-15 August 1947. First woman CM AFTER her: Nandini Satpathy (Odisha, 1972), Shashikala Kakodkar (Goa, 1973), Anwara Taimur (Assam, 1980), Sheila Dikshit (Delhi, 1998), Jayalalithaa (TN, 1991), Mayawati (UP, 1995), Rabri Devi (Bihar, 1997), Uma Bharti (MP, 2003), Vasundhara Raje (Raj, 2003), Mamata Banerjee (WB, 2011), Anandiben Patel (Guj, 2014), Mehbooba Mufti (J&K, 2016). India has had ~16 women CMs.

questions.stem: Who was India's first Chief Election Commissioner?
questions.explanation: SUKUMAR SEN (ICS officer) served as India's first Chief Election Commissioner from 21 March 1950 to 19 December 1958 — conducted the first and second Lok Sabha elections (1951-52 and 1957). T. N. SESHAN (10th CEC, 1990-96) — reformed ECI's functioning, earning the popular title 'Tyrant'. K. V. K. Sundaram was the 2nd CEC (1958-67). James Michael Lyngdoh (12th CEC, 2001-04) — presided over contentious Gujarat 2002 elections; Magsaysay Award 2003. Current CEC (as of early 2025): Rajiv Kumar. The ECI is a constitutional body under Article 324 — originally 1 CEC, now 3 (1 CEC + 2 ECs) since 1993.

questions.stem: Who was the first woman judge of the Supreme Court of India?
questions.explanation: Justice M. FATHIMA BEEVI (1927-2023) became the FIRST woman judge of the Supreme Court of India in 1989 (served till 1992). She was also the first Muslim woman judge in any high court in India (Kerala HC, 1983) and later Governor of Tamil Nadu (1997-2001). ANNA CHANDY was India's first woman HIGH COURT judge (Kerala HC, 1959) — not SC. Leila Seth — first woman CHIEF JUSTICE of a High Court (HP HC, 1991) and first woman judge of Delhi HC. Justice Indu Malhotra (2018-2021) — first woman appointed directly from the Bar to SC. By Sept 2021, the SC had a record 4 women judges simultaneously (Hima Kohli, BV Nagarathna, Bela Trivedi — appointed together; Indira Banerjee was already serving).

questions.stem: Which was the first Indian-made fully indigenous supersonic fighter aircraft, inducted into the IAF in 2016?
questions.explanation: HAL TEJAS (Light Combat Aircraft, LCA) — 4.5-generation single-engine multirole fighter — was formally inducted into the IAF on 1 July 2016 (No. 45 Squadron 'Flying Daggers'). Designed by ADA (Aeronautical Development Agency) + HAL. Project started 1983 to replace MiG-21s; first flight 2001; full operational clearance 2019. Tejas Mk-1A on order (83 aircraft, Feb 2021). HAL MARUT (HF-24) was India's first indigenous fighter (1961-85) — but subsonic-to-transonic, not truly supersonic. Su-30MKI is imported (Russian, license-built in India). HAL PRACHAND (Light Combat Helicopter, 2022) — indigenous attack helicopter. ARJUN MBT is indigenous main battle tank.

questions.stem: The first INC session was held at Bombay in 1885. Who presided over it as its first President?
questions.explanation: The Indian National Congress's FIRST session (28-31 December 1885 at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College, Bombay) was presided by Womesh Chandra BONNERJEE (Kolkata barrister). 72 delegates. A. O. Hume (British, retired ICS) was the FOUNDER/organiser — called the 'father of INC' but never its President. DADABHAI NAOROJI (Grand Old Man of India) presided 3 times (1886, 1893, 1906 — where the Swaraj demand was first articulated). SURENDRANATH BANERJEE — founded earlier Indian National Association (1876), twice INC president (1895, 1902). First woman INC president: Annie Besant (1917 Calcutta). First Indian woman: Sarojini Naidu (1925 Kanpur). Youngest INC President: Jawaharlal Nehru (1929 Lahore — 'Purna Swaraj' declaration).

questions.stem: Who was the first Indian to go to space?
questions.explanation: Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma (IAF pilot) became the FIRST Indian in space on 3 April 1984 aboard the Soviet Soyuz T-11 to Salyut 7 space station — spent 7 days 21 hours. When PM Indira Gandhi asked him how India looked from space, he famously replied 'Saare Jahan Se Achha' (a line from Iqbal's poem). KALPANA CHAWLA (Karnal, Haryana; naturalised US citizen) was the FIRST woman of Indian origin in space (STS-87, Nov 1997) and died in the Columbia disaster on 1 Feb 2003 (STS-107 re-entry). SUNITA WILLIAMS (Indian-American) — multiple ISS missions; holds records for spacewalks by a woman. India's GAGANYAAN manned mission target: 2026. Shubhanshu Shukla expected to be India's 2nd astronaut.
